sentences.en: The entire theater turned to chaos when somebody cried "Fire!".
sentences.zh: 有人喊了一声‘着火了！’整个剧院顿时陷入混乱。

sentences.en: People were running over each other. It was complete chaos.
sentences.zh: 人们互相踩踏。完全是一片混乱。

sentences.en: When the king died, the kingdom was thrown into chaos.
sentences.zh: 国王去世后，整个王国陷入了动乱之中。
